known_gaps: turning the customer's words into negotiation events (and dates into YYYY-MM-DD) is done by the dialogue model; offers, counters, dates, amounts, read-back, recording, notes and the close are code
callback window validity is decided by the dialogue model from code-computed window facts (not code)
identity flow (which question, re-asks, declines) follows the dialogue model with the bank's verification results

extra rule (stateful, stage opening): Confirmation of the person on the line: ask up to twice; only explicit confirmations count; answering a customer question (robot/scam) comes first and the following ask is the second ask; close not_reached/unclear after the second unclear ask. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (computational, stage identity): Convert spoken dates of birth to YYYY-MM-DD; numeric-only dates are read day, month, year. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Track total wrong identity answers across both questions (three ends the check); a day_month_swapped retry is not counted. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Declining identity: explain once that the questions protect the account; a second refusal or a second 'what is this about' closes not_verified/declined. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (computational, stage negotiate): Resolve 'next <weekday>' as that weekday in the following calendar week and 'this <weekday>' as the one in the current week. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Floor offered once after 'too much', and below-floor amount answered with one floor offer; refusal of the floor or of the deadline counts as a flat refusal. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Count persuasion attempts per band; customer-proposed dates/amounts are never refusals; do not repeat a refused offer; close no_promise/refused when attempts are used up. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Hardship takes precedence over persuasion and restructuring: one sympathy sentence, no persuasion, offer support transfer; but a self-named date or amount is still recorded. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): A change of date or amount at read-back invalidates the confirmation; re-check and read back again before create_promise. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): One promise per product; a recorded promise cannot be changed in the call; direct change requests to the mobile app. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage global): Human request: ask once whether you can help first; transfer to general only if they insist; applies before and after verification. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage closing): If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as transferred with that transfer's reason (not promise). - left to the dialogue model's prompt
checks: first security answer reaches verify_identity with the right field
no account or write call before verification
negotiation stage reached with account facts
every product's past-due amount stated in the debt statement, before any offer

code: deadline per band (Nth business day after now, calendar from the policy)
promise date validity (past / after deadline / non-business day)
vague period: ask 1 time(s), then the deadline
amount: full first, floor offer after 'too much' or a below-floor amount, accept floor..full
read-back of the whole package, confirmation bound to that package, writes only from the confirmed package
hardship: one code-owned sympathy+support offer, no persuasion afterwards, customer's own date/amount kept
notes per product (not used by this brief), none after a transfer; close outcome from recorded/transfer/product results
goodbye -> notes -> exactly one close_call in the negotiation path
model: turning the customer's words into events and dates into YYYY-MM-DD (calendar table given)
identity question order, re-asks, declines (bank result routes to the account step)
opening confirmation and its re-ask count
third party, callback window validity and re-ask
transfer decision and queue (close mapping is code)
questions outside payment (robot/scam answers come from the policy)
unsupported_by_code: Convert spoken dates of birth to YYYY-MM-DD; numeric-only dates are read day, month, year.
